settings.editor: I help sales leaders and business owners grow revenue and protect margin, using the apps, automations and AI we build at Zoxima.

settings.title: I start with how your team sells, not with technology.

settings.editor:
Most companies already have the answers they need. They are just split across the ERP, the CRM, price lists, emails and WhatsApp chats, and none of these talk to each other.

My work is to sit with your team, understand how you sell today, and show you, on your own data, which customers can buy more and where margin is slipping away. Then we fix it step by step.
More revenue and healthier margin are the goal. AI is only the way we get there.
We build on top of the tools you already have. Nothing gets ripped out.
Technology finds the opportunity. Your sales team builds the relationship and wins it.
Zoxima is a Fremont, California based apps, automations and AI company with offices in Delhi NCR. Our product Salezx is an AI Sales Brain that helps companies sell more and protect margin.
